title: hieracium substoloniferum
intro: Hieracium substoloniferum, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a flowering plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). The plant is rich in health benefits, including its use as a natural remedy for various ailments such as skin issues and digestive problems, due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Hawkweed are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, soothe skin irritations, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium substoloniferum include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
